author: Robert27384
quote: This game forces you to buy Lucia a necklace and flowers, even though she’s a slut who abandoned Jason’s son without telling him. How did this series end up with writing this bad? The graphics are the only thing saving it, but it’s still the worst GTA yet. I got a refund.

author: Robert27384
quote: That's a lazy DLC of BOTW but not a new Zelda. There's no way it tooks 6 years of development. There's not even graphics improvments. The Switch can definitively do better.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
